en.headline: Police arrest three over missing fire door frames in public estate lift works
en.dek: A company director and two registered engineers were detained on fraud suspicions after EMSD found 48 lifts at two estates lacked required components.
body: Police from the New Territories South Regional Crime Unit arrested three men on Friday on suspicion of fraud in connection with lift replacement works that omitted fire-resistant door frame components at two Tenants Purchase Scheme estates.

The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department earlier identified deficiencies involving 48 lifts — 39 at Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin and nine at Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong — where only the fire-resisting doors were installed while corresponding door frame parts were missing, despite completion reports claiming the works were finished.

Those arrested include a 79-year-old company shareholder and director, an 82-year-old staff engineer and a 63-year-old external consulting engineer linked to Taizoom Elevator Company (HK) Limited. Officers searched the company's office in Chai Wan and seized documents.

EMSD said the missing components amount to non-compliance but the lifts can still operate safely. The department has ordered remedial installation at the contractor's expense and is inspecting other buildings fitted by the same firm, finding similar omissions in 39 additional properties as of Friday afternoon. EMSD has referred the matter to police and will pursue enforcement under the Lifts and Escalators Ordinance.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕三人涉公屋升降機工程欠裝耐火門框
zh.dek: 機電署發現兩屋苑48部升降機未裝所需門框組件，一名董事及兩名註冊工程師因涉嫌欺詐被扣留。
body: 警方新界南總區重案組周五拘捕三名男子，他們涉嫌在兩座租者置其屋計劃屋苑的升降機更換工程中，遺漏安裝耐火門框組件，並涉及欺詐。
機電工程署早前發現博康邨及翠屏北邨合共48部升降機有嚴重缺失，承辦商只安裝了耐火門，卻沒有安裝對應的門框組件，卻報稱工程完成。
被捕人士包括79歲的公司股東兼董事、82歲的註冊工程師及63歲的外聘顧問工程師，均與臺日電梯（香港）有限公司有關。探員搜查該公司柴灣辦公室並檢走文件。
機電署指缺少門框組件屬違規，但升降機仍可安全運作。署方已要求承辦商自費盡快補裝，並正巡查該公司在其他樓宇安裝的升降機，截至周五下午已發現另外39幢樓宇有類似問題。機電署已將案件轉介警方，並會根據《升降機及自動梯條例》採取執法行動。
